integrity.computation: Exact integer enumeration of all 272 matchings, 24 faces and 64 move-type subsets

scientific_limitations: No extension to higher-dimensional cubes or longer-cycle switches
No excited-state gap or mixing-time calculation
Finite exhaustive proof with two independent matching encodings and two graph algorithms; not an infinite-size theorem
Historical priority outside examined full-text sources cannot be ruled out
scientific_scope: All 64 subsets of six coordinate-plane types of elementary square moves on perfect matchings of the sixteen-vertex binary four-cube; finite RK plaquette Hamiltonians with positive enabled coefficients.
title: Exact directional fragmentation of quantum dimers on the four-cube
